description: Returns the complete, copy-ready React/TSX source of one component as designed, plus notes on its images and any extra files it needs. Components use Tailwind CSS classes and import react, framer-motion and lucide-react; a few also need gsap or three, which the response names with the install command. Use it once you know the exact name; use get_component_styled instead when the component should take on an extracted brand style. Without a premium key, source comes back for the free components, the first six of every category, which list_components and search_components mark as "free"; other names return a notice on how to get a key.

name.description: Component name as listed by list_components or search_components, e.g. 'OrbitGalleryHero'. Matching ignores case.

name: get_component
title: Get component source
